notes.title: Game Update and Fix - April 2021
notes.content:
In response to some user reviews, we have improved some aspects of the game.


- Decrease in the total time of the vehicle maps.


- Increase in the number of enemies on vehicle maps.


- Improved pistol shooting system.


- Player death animation fixed.


- Câmera Shake in explosions.


- New Post Processing Effects

Thank you!
